Use case: scientific-educational.
Create ONE complete, polished landscape 16:9 scientific roadmap illustration for the seven SUNHAOJUN22 repositories. This is an AI-generated explanatory schematic, not a data plot. It must look like a clear publication figure with an elegant light ivory background, fine dark typography, subtle physical 3D motifs, compact editorial composition, and color-coded panels. All areas, including the bottom, must contain meaningful organized content; no empty lower half. Avoid glowing sci-fi clutter, robot faces, fake numerical plots, fake logos, or collages.
Title, exact: "PHYSICS-GUIDED SCIENTIFIC WORKFLOW"
Subtitle, exact: "Seven independent repositories • proposed interfaces"
Use seven distinct readable cards, in two balanced rows (four above, three below), with thin DOTTED connecting lines identified by the small legend "Dotted links: proposed handoffs". Do not imply these integrations are already implemented.
Cards and exact body text:
1 "TsaoSciResearcher" in burgundy/rose. "Question → evidence → qualified claim". Small motif: connected evidence records.
2 "TsaoSciComputation" in teal/navy. "Model → execution → verification". Small motif: continuum mesh and molecule.
3 "TsaoDFT_skill" in violet/blue. "Electronic structure → reaction energetics". Small motif: electron-density-inspired orbital.
4 "ResinDB-Pro-by-SunHJ" in amber/petrol. "Quantity + unit + condition → materials decision". Small motif: polymer chain and database.
5 "AspenOps-Agent" in cobalt/cyan. "Validated process intent → licensed solver → engineering review". Small motif: restrained reactor/column flowsheet.
6 "TSAO-PROCESSING-SKILL" in emerald/copper. "Kinetics → transport → processing reference". Small motif: flow channel and polymer chains.
7 "OpenDeepMind_skill" in indigo/gold. "Foundations → first principles → validation". Add small text "TRIZ: explicit opt-in". Small motif: clean branching hypothesis lattice.
Below the cards, a beautiful full-width slim mathematical ribbon headed "Equilibrium context · fixed N, V, T". Set these four short equations precisely and legibly:
"β = 1/(k_B T)"
"Z = Σ_i exp(−β E_i)"
"p_i = exp(−β E_i)/Z"
"F = −k_B T ln Z"
A small line directly below defines "T > 0; E_i: state energy; k_B: Boltzmann constant".
A second very compact footer text strip: "Units • finite values • conservation • uncertainty • traceable evidence".
A final small clearly readable footer at bottom right: "AI-generated schematic • illustrative, not measured data".
The formulas are theoretical context; do not place fake benchmark claims or scores. Draw the entire figure as one coherent generated raster. Every card has a concise caption, no blank panels. English spelling must be exact; legible at README width. Hierarchy: title, seven cards, equation ribbon, footer. Keep the roadmap simple with ample breathing room inside this compact structure.
